name: analyze_stories
description:
MCP tool for analyzing user stories grouped by tags.

Stories should be tagged first using add_story_tag or tag_stories tools.
This tool then groups stories by their tags to inform architecture design.

Returns a structured view of stories organized by domain/feature tags.

name: check_architecture
description:
Compares the planned architecture against live code and reports where
they disagree: an unplanned dependency, a planned dependency the code
never uses, a planned component with no code, or code with no planned
owner (story 1085).

Always runnable, including when this project's `architecture` setting is
`:off` — off only changes what the stop hook then does with a finding
(nothing blocks), not whether a check can be requested.

name: execute_proposal
description:
Manually executes the architecture proposal at `.code_my_spec/architecture/proposal.md`.

In patch mode the architect can choose between two paths: the small
incremental tools (`create_component`, `set_story_component`) for one-off
additions, or rewriting `proposal.md` for larger restructures. When the
architect picks the rewrite path, this tool applies the rewritten proposal
— reads the file, validates it, and creates/updates components and links.

Returns success when the proposal is valid and execution completes, or an
error response with feedback when validation fails.

name: regenerate_proposal
description:
Rewrite `proposal.md` from the architecture that actually exists.

The round trip was half built. `Proposal.from_markdown/2` turns the document
into components and has an MCP tool driving it; `ProposalProjector.project/1`
turns components back into the document and had no caller anywhere — written,
tested in shape, and unreachable.

That gap is what makes revision mode awkward. A project with 910 components
and no `proposal.md` is not undesigned; it is designed and undocumented, and
the only way to get a document describing it was to write one by hand. This
produces it from the database instead, which is the one source that already
agrees with the spec stubs the graph is built from.

Writes through the environment for the selected working copy, including a
remote harness when the server does not hold the checkout.

Not automatic. Regenerating discards whatever the file said, and a proposal
under active edit is worth more than one that matches the database, so the
overwrite is something a caller asks for rather than something a task does on
its way past.

confirm.description: Must be true. Regenerating replaces proposal.md with the current architecture, discarding any unexecuted edits.

name: show_architecture_overview
description:
Returns the component overview organized by context.

Shows all components grouped by parent context with types, descriptions,
and dependency listings.

name: show_namespace_hierarchy
description:
The project's components as a module-namespace tree: the first thing to read
for an architectural overview. Two levels by default; `prefix` and `depth`
open one subtree further. A node cut off by the depth shows `(+N)`, the
components below it.

depth.description: Levels to show below the prefix (from the top without one). Default 2.

name: validate_dependency_graph
description:
Validates the component dependency graph for circular dependencies.

Returns validation result indicating success or detailed list of detected cycles.
Circular dependencies violate clean architecture principles and make code
harder to test and maintain.
